jr20xx repo

This is a repository of apps to be used with F-Droid. Applications in this repository are official binaries built by jr20xx (https://github.com/jr20xx) using the tools on https://gitlab.com/fdroid.

Currently it serves 0 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://example.com/fdroid/repo
